title: Algebraic degree and Hamming norm
statement: Let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$ be a nonzero Boolean function, and suppose its algebraic degree (the maximum size of a set indexing a nonzero coefficient in its algebraic normal form) is at most $k$. Then $2^{n-k}\le \|f\|_0$, where $\|f\|_0$ is the Hamming norm, the number of inputs on which $f$ is nonzero.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $\mathbb F_2^n$
the algebraic degree of $f$ is at most $k$
